promise: Seven to eight new semiconductor production plants will become operational within the next one to two years
description: In his Independence Day 2026 address from the Red Fort on August 15, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said 7-8 new semiconductor production plants are expected to become operational within the next one to two years, strengthening India's domestic chip manufacturing capability as part of the self-reliance push. The one-to-two-year timeline is used to set the review horizon.
evidence: August 15, 2026 Independence Day speech announcing 7-8 new semiconductor plants in 1-2 years
Timeline of 1-2 years implies operational by August 2028 at the latest
